Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misapplied ordinal succession logic and ignored the explicit WebSurfer result stating the 16th Earl’s father is the 15th Earl. They incorrectly concluded the paternal grandfather would be the 14th Earl (subtracting two generations) instead of correctly identifying the 15th Earl (father of the 16th), leading the search down the wrong path.
